notes: Same checked Rust workloads before and after page-identity materialization.
Before is the release benchmark built from the clean baseline commit.
Three processes per workload, size and revision; order alternates.
Navigation measures a completed down/up destination cycle, not one key.
Navigation fixtures contain 10000 or 50000 articles and the owned source catalog.
Smoothness fixtures contain 2000/20000 articles and 20/200 smart lists.
Frames use TestBackend; physical input/emulator latency is not measured.
Process resources include fixture generation and application setup.
Percentiles belong to each process; they are not pooled percentiles.
After identifies the pre-overlay implementation snapshot; page SQL is unchanged in the final integration. Image/overlay costs are measured separately in image-inspection-benchmarks.json.
